svg.aria-label: The real two-window trace. The log numbers 43 events of one session. A, the TUI, attached first and gets each one live. B, a web page, connects 6.081 seconds in and attaches with after_seq 0. Seq 1 to 9 come to it as one replay, then the reply says last_seq 9. From seq 10 on, A and B get each event in the same millisecond. Neither gets an event twice, or misses one.
svg.text: 1 created · 2–4 your line, run, answer started · 5–41 deltas · 42 done · 43 run
Real, from a throwaway daemon with qwen3.5:4b: B's hello, then session.attach with after_seq 0.
The replay, seq 1 to 9, and the reply came at 6.083 s. Seq 10 reached A and B at 6.092 s.
Neither window got an event twice, or missed one.
